rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for the fresh fruit, especially table grapes.

example.english: These grapes are sweet and juicy, perfect for making grape juice.
example.traditional: 呢啲提子又甜又多汁，最啱整果汁。
example.jyutping: nei1 di1 tai4 zi2 jau6 tim4 jau6 do1 zap1 zeoi3 ngaam1 zing2 gwo2 zap1

rows.note: Use this straightforward general term when referring to grapes as a fruit or in compounds such as grape juice.

example.english: I had a glass of grape juice this morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jam2 zo2 bui1 pou4 tou4 zap1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the woody vine or plant that bears grapes.

example.english: This grape vine has grown really lush this year.
example.traditional: 呢棵葡萄藤今年生得好茂盛。
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 pou4 tou4 tang4 gam1 nin4 saang1 dak1 hou2 mau6 sing6
